description: A full splat on an empty list is an error when its attribute access can't apply to the element type
notes: The spec says a splat is approximately equivalent to a for expression, which gives an empty result for an empty list without evaluating anything per element. hashicorp/hcl finds the element type of the empty result list by applying the traversal to an unknown value of the list's element type, so a traversal that can't apply to strings is an error (SplatExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
